name: Nikola Jovanović
bio:
Nikola's meticulous nature and passion for precision led him to a career in motorsport. Growing up in Belgrade, he was captivated by the engineering behind racing cars, spending hours disassembling and reassembling anything mechanical he could get his hands on. This hands-on experience, combined with a degree in mechanical engineering, made him a natural fit for quality control.

At Red Bull Racing, Nikola is known for his unwavering commitment to ensuring every component meets the highest standards. He believes in a proactive approach, identifying potential issues before they escalate. His calm demeanor under pressure allows him to effectively troubleshoot complex problems, making him an invaluable asset to the team. He strives to bring a methodical and innovative approach to quality assurance, pushing the boundaries of what is possible.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Nikola is of average height with a focused gaze and a lean build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on his desk when deep in thought.
Insists on calibrating his equipment at the start of every day, regardless of whether it's needed.
